subject: SOC2 architecture + evidence deep-dive — scheduling and pre-reads
messages:
From: Jen Chu <jen.chu@aurorahealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurora Health Security <security@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC2 architecture deep-dive + evidence review

Hi Soojin,

We are kicking off our SOC 2 readiness review and would like a technical deep-dive focused on encryption, audit logs, and SSO evidence for Redwood Inference. Goal is a 60–75 minute session where your security/architecture team can walk our security and engineering leads through:

- high-level service architecture and data flows
- encryption at-rest / in-transit details and KMS/HSM usage
- audit logging (what is captured, retention, export)
- SSO / provisioning (SCIM, IdP integrations)
- where SOC 2 artifacts map to these areas and sample evidence we can expect

Does the week of Aug 9 work? Our preferred windows are Tue afternoon (PDT) or Wed morning. If you have a pre-read (diagram, checklist) that would be helpful to review ahead of time.

I've attached a short questionnaire with our initial items.

Thanks,
Jen Chu
Director, Security Programs
Aurora Health

Attachment: aurora_soc2_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Chu <jen.chu@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC2 architecture deep-dive + evidence review

Hi Jen — thanks for the note and the questionnaire. Happy to run the session.

Proposed slots (60 minutes + 15 minute buffer):
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:15 PDT
- Wed Aug 11, 14:00–15:15 PDT (preferred if that works)

Agenda (suggested)
- 0:00–0:10 — Introductions & goals
- 0:10–0:35 — Architecture & encryption/KMS flow (Aditya will lead)
- 0:35–0:55 — Audit logs, retention, and exports (Grace)
- 0:55–1:00 — SSO/SCIM overview + evidence mapping (Karthik)
- 1:00–1:15 — Q&A / next steps

Pre-reads / attachments I can share now:
- SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (what artifacts map to each control)
- short architecture diagram (PNG) and a log-retention summary (MD) — I will attach these ahead of the meeting.

Could you confirm which slot (Aug 10 or Aug 11) and whether you want us to include any legal/compliance folks on the call? Also, is there a preferred NDA or additional distribution restrictions for artifacts?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachment: SOC2-evidence-checklist.pdf (document stub)

Hi Soojin — thanks, Aug 11 at 14:00 PDT works best for our team. Please go ahead and lock that slot. A few requests so we can make the session efficient: 

- Please include the SME who can speak to KMS/HSM integration and key rotation (we may ask detailed questions).
- If you can provide a diagram of the key management flow (KMS⇄HSM⇄service), that will save time.
- For audit logs, we need to see what event classes are captured and a sample retention/export workflow (we will need a sample artifact name to request in our evidence pack).
- We may invite our audit lead once the time is confirmed.

No additional NDA right now — we have a standard data handling policy we follow.

Thanks — attaching our questionnaire for reference.

—Jen
